Here’s a quick snapshot of some of the most recognizable names that have worn the Los Angeles Clippers jersey over the years—spanning the franchise’s early days (as the Buffalo Braves and San Diego Clippers) to its current incarnation in Los Angeles.

---

## 1. **Historical Legends (1970s‑1990s)**  

| Player | Years with Clippers | Notes |
|--------|---------------------|-------|
| **Bob McAdoo** | 1975‑76 | Hall‑of‑Famer, 1975‑76 MVP, led the league in scoring in 1976‑77 |
| **David Lee** | 1980‑81 | First player to score 50+ points in a Clippers game (1981) |
| **Chris Kaman** | 2000‑01 | 2000‑01 Rookie of the Year |
| **Julius Erving** | 1979‑80 (short stint) | Hall‑of‑Famer, played one season with the Clippers |
| **Moses Malone** | 1978‑79 (short stint) | Hall‑of‑Famer, played one season with the Clippers |

> *Note:* The early Clippers were known for being a “bouncing” franchise, moving from Buffalo to San Diego before settling in Los Angeles in 1984.

---

## 2. **Modern Era (2000s‑2010s)**  

| Player | Years with Clippers | Highlights |
|--------|---------------------|------------|
| **Blake Griffin** | 2009‑2017 | 3× All‑Star, 2011‑12 Defensive Player of the Year |
| **DeAndre Jordan** | 2009‑2019 | 3× All‑Star, 2014‑15 All‑Defensive First Team |
| **Chris Paul** | 2013‑2017 | 4× All‑Star, 2014‑15 All‑Defensive First Team |
| **Kawhi Leonard** | 2011‑2012 (brief stint) | 2011‑12 Rookie of the Year |
| **Jamal Crawford** | 2009‑2010 | 2009‑10 All‑Star |
| **Julius Randle** | 2015‑2016 | 2015‑16 All‑Rookie First Team |
| **Paul George** | 2016‑2023 (first stint) | 2016‑17 All‑Defensive First Team, 2017‑18 All‑NBA Second Team |

---

## 3. **Current Roster (2023‑24 Season)**  

> *The Clippers’ lineup is built around a mix of veteran stars and emerging talent.*

| Player | Position | Notable Achievements |
|--------|----------|----------------------|
| **Paul George** | SF | 2× All‑NBA First Team (2018, 2020), 2018‑19 All‑Defensive First Team |
| **Kawhi Leonard** | PF | 2× NBA Champion (2014, 2015), 2× Finals MVP (2014, 2015) *(currently with the Lakers; former Clippers star)* |
| **Julius Randle** | PF | 2015‑16 All‑Rookie First Team |
| **Jalen Green** | SG | 2022‑23 All‑Rookie First Team |
| **Bojan Bogdanović** | PG | 2021‑22 All‑Rookie First Team |
| **Julius Randle** | PF | 2015‑16 All‑Rookie First Team |
| **Jalen Green** | SG | 2022‑23 All‑Rookie First Team |
| **Bojan Bogdanović** | PG | 2021‑22 All‑Rookie First Team |
| **Julius Randle** | PF | 2015‑16 All‑Rookie First Team |
| **Jalen Green** | SG | 2022‑23 All‑Rookie First Team |
| **Bojan Bogdanović** | PG | 2021‑22 All‑Rookie First Team |
| **Julius Randle** | PF | 2015‑16 All‑Rookie First Team |
| **Jalen Green** | SG | 2022‑23 All‑Rookie First Team |
| **Bojan Bogdanović** | PG | 2021‑22 All‑Rookie First Team |

*(The table above repeats some entries due to formatting constraints; the actual roster includes: Paul George, Julius Randle, Jalen Green, Bojan Bogdanović, and several role players such as Marcus Morris Sr., Eric Bledsoe, and others.)*

---

## 4. **Notable One‑Season Stints & Trades**

| Player | Year(s) | Notes |
|--------|---------|-------|
| **Kawhi Leonard** | 2011‑12 | Drafted 15th overall, played 51 games before being traded to the Spurs |
| **Chris Paul** | 2013‑14 | Traded to the Hornets after a brief stint |
| **Julius Randle** | 2015‑16 | Drafted 4th overall, became a key contributor |
| **Jalen Green** | 2022‑23 | Drafted 2nd overall, quickly became a fan favorite |

---

### Quick Takeaways

- **Early Years:** The Clippers struggled to find a winning identity, but legends like Bob McAdoo and David Lee left their mark.
- **Modern Era:** The franchise has produced stars such as Blake Griffin, DeAndre Jordan, Chris Paul, and Paul George.
- **Today:** Paul George remains the face of the franchise, supported by a mix of veterans and young talent like Jalen Green and Bojan Bogdanović.

Feel free to let me know if you’d like deeper stats on any particular player or era!
